decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason:
The application to vary Condition 35 (Cycle parking spaces) of approved planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8/12/06 by replacing "Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details shall have been submitted to and approved?" with "Before the development hereby permitted is occupied details shall have been submitted to and approved?" would not affect the intention of the condition as imposed, being the provision and making available of cycle parking spaces prior to occupation of the development.  It is further noted that Conditions 26 (Landscape design proposals (hard and soft landscape works)) and 36 (Parking) of planning permission 00505/P/P59 both require details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority e before occupation.

Replacement condition:
Before the development hereby permitted is occupied details shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority showing a total of 600 cycle parking spaces within the curtilage of the site.  These cycle parking spaces shall, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, be provided before first occupation of the buildings within each of the relevant phases and such spaces shall be permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose.
description: Variation of Condition 35 of approved planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 08/12/2006 to read as follows "Before the development hereby permitted is occupied details shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority showing a total of 600 cycle parking spaces within the curtilage of the site.  These cycle parking spaces shall, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, be provided before the first occupation of the buildings within each of the relevant phases and such spaces shall be permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose."
